component.name: DrukhalManager
component.summary: Manage Stellaris mods and merge their conflicts

description.p: A native Linux mod manager for Stellaris that edits your load order, finds where mods conflict, and merges them into a patch so every mod's changes survive.
A fork of Irony Mod Manager by Mario (bcssov), rewritten in Rust with GTK and libadwaita.

ul.li: Edit the load order and keep several collections, synced to the Paradox Launcher
Find files and objects that several mods change
Merge conflicts with AI, or pick a version, into a patch mod
Repair files with brace mistakes and broken mod descriptors
See which mods caused the errors the game logged
